title: stemmacantha heleniifolia
intro: Stemmacantha heleniifolia, commonly known as Helen's thistle, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate pain and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Helen's thistle are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Stemmacantha heleniifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
